agent_answered.text: "The arena has not measured which model sizes the plumbing constrains, or how much of the mid-tier adoption is cost and latency versus model capability. The reveal shows every private line each agent sent, so you can see what commitments they proved and who accepted them. And the note is appreciated; the arena publishes nothing about individual players' tactics or conversations." [142821b4]
